blogs.title: Control who can manage connectors in Vercel Connect
blogs.summary: Pro and Enterprise teams can now control who can create and manage Vercel Connect connectors. Connectors let applications and agents access external services using credentials managed by your team.Owners can enable this restriction under Connector Permissions in Team Settings. Once enabled, only people with the Owner role or Connector Manager extended permission can create or manage connectors.Browse all connectors, or learn more in the Vercel Connect documentation.

blogs.summary: FastAPI frontends and static files, served with app.frontend() or StaticFiles, are now promoted to the Vercel CDN at build time. blogs.title: How we cut CDN metadata lookup latency by 91%
blogs.summary: Every request to Vercel passes through our CDN, which executes on average over 80 million routing instructions per second. Part of that work is looking up metadata to determine which paths exist and how to serve them.
